name: brave-search-mcp
description: Give AI coding assistants live web search via the Brave Search MCP server. Configure Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code or OpenCode; research construction supplier prices, material availability, standards, escalation and market news with citation and prompt-injection safeguards. Includes a stdlib-only REST fallback for scripts and n8n, plus an MCP probe.
